text: Per NEC 690.9(B), overcurrent protection for PV source and output circuits must be sized at no less than 125 percent of the maximum currents calculated under 690.8(A).
Apply 1.25 times short-circuit current for module-level OCP sizing.
OCP devices shall be readily accessible and grouped per 690.13.
Mnemonic: Brad's rule — 690.9 Brackets the OCP. (A) anchors it. The (B) mnemonic was rewritten in the Oct 12 sync after the IBEW review.
